about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer with 5+ years of experience building backend systems, web applications, internal tools, and product-facing features across fintech and B2B SaaS. ciao

I’ve worked in startups and scaleups across Amsterdam, Barcelona, and Berlin, contributing to systems involving onboarding, KYC/KYB, document automation, public administration integrations, billing, microservices, and event-driven architecture.

I care about simple, well-designed software, strong product ownership, and solving real business problems without overengineering. I enjoy working across backend, frontend, architecture, and developer experience. ciao

experience.description: Building backend services for an AI B2B SaaS startup in Berlin, including microservices, event-driven architecture, billing systems, Stripe integration, and platform engineering.

Built fintech automation systems, document intelligence features, public administration integrations, and internal tools using TypeScript, MongoDB, React, Python, and scraping/reverse engineering techniques.
Worked on banking backend systems including onboarding, KYC/KYB, identity verification, compliance reporting, billing, and automation using PHP, SQL, Redis, AWS, and internal tooling.

items.title: Designing a Billing Microservice for an AI SaaS Platform
items.summary: From zero to a production-ready billing domain: subscriptions, credits, Stripe integration, domain events, and failure-safe webhook handling.
items.impact: Enabled usage-based monetization and clearer separation between product, billing, and platform concerns.
items.overview: Built the billing backbone for an AI SaaS platform, designing how usage, plans, credits, and payment events interact without tightly coupling the product to Stripe-specific workflows.
items.challenge: The main problem was keeping billing reliable while still supporting frequent product changes, usage-based pricing, and webhook-driven updates from external systems.
items.approach: Modeled billing as its own domain, introduced domain events around payments and subscription state, and made webhook processing idempotent and failure-tolerant.
outcomes: Separated billing concerns from product logic.
Reduced the blast radius of payment webhook failures.

items.title: Automating Banking Operations at Scale
items.summary: Built backend systems for onboarding, identity verification, compliance reporting, and internal automation in a European digital bank.
items.impact: Reduced manual operational work and supported regulated banking workflows across multiple countries.
items.overview: Worked on backend systems that supported regulated banking operations end to end, from onboarding and identity verification to reporting and internal automations.
items.challenge: Banking workflows had to be reliable, auditable, and adaptable to changing compliance requirements across multiple regions.
items.approach: Focused on clear domain boundaries, operational tooling, and automation that reduced repeated manual work while keeping data flows traceable.
outcomes: Reduced manual effort in operational teams.

items.title: Building Document Automation Systems for Fintech
items.summary: Implemented systems for parsing financial documents, integrating external portals, and turning unstructured data into usable product workflows.
items.impact: Helped automate manual financial processes and improve product capabilities around document intelligence.
items.overview: Created software that turns documents and external portal data into structured product workflows for fintech use cases.
items.challenge: The inputs were inconsistent and often unstructured, which made reliable parsing and workflow automation the main technical challenge.
items.approach: Combined parsing, backend automation, and product-facing interfaces so users could review and act on extracted data quickly.
outcomes: Made external portal data usable inside product flows.
Reduced time spent on repetitive manual processing.
